tax.text: He urged passage of a bill to expand Social Security benefits, funded in part by higher contributions from high earners.
tax.quote: The Social Security 2100 Act changes that. It makes the wealthy pay their fair share, boosts benefits

wages.text: He defended collective bargaining, saying it supports living wages and workers’ rights.
wages.quote: It ensures living wages, safe working conditions, and a pathway to the middle class.

trade.text: He led efforts to rescind tariffs on Canada, arguing they raise costs and threaten jobs.
trade.quote: All these tariffs will do is destroy centuries of goodwill between our neighbors, create a new consumer tax on Americans who are already struggling to make ends meet, and cost jobs.

debt.text: He urged Congress to strengthen Social Security and expand its benefits rather than reduce them.
debt.quote: I won’t stop fighting to save Social Security and ensure that future generations can receive the benefits they have paid into and have rightfully earned.

housing.text: His official issues page identifies increasing housing supply as a priority.
housing.quote: Making housing more affordable and increasing supply Providing incentives to rehabilitate historic buildings

schools.text: He fought to restore funding to public schools and districts in need.
schools.quote: He led the fight to eliminate the Gap Elimination Adjustment (GEA), which unfairly slashed billions from our public schools.

safety.text: He supported COPS grants for police while also emphasizing community investment to address crime’s root causes.
safety.quote: Our police, sheriffs, and troopers put their lives on the line to keep our neighborhoods safe and these resources support that important work.

immigration.text: He opposes expanded immigration enforcement tactics and calls for a fairer, lawful, and humane system.
immigration.quote: Instead of working to build a fairer immigration system, this administration has chosen to demonize immigrants and expand enforcement tactics that are reckless, dangerous, and inhumane.

guns.text: He supports universal background checks and other restrictions on firearms and related equipment.
guns.quote: Pass universal background checks for all firearm purchases

abortion.text: He called for codifying Roe v. Wade and protecting abortion rights.
abortion.quote: Together, we will codify Roe v. Wade into law and protect women’s reproductive freedoms.

gender.text: He voted against the Protection of Women and Girls in Sports Act, which would have based Title IX athletic rules on reproductive biology and genetics at birth.
gender.quote: Protection of Women and Girls in Sports Act

health.text: He supports protecting and expanding the Affordable Care Act and investing in health services.
health.quote: Protect and expand the Affordable Care Act

energy.text: He supports legislation to cut carbon emissions and strengthen the green energy economy.
energy.quote: Rep. Kennedy is committed to advancing policies that address the urgent threat of climate change, safeguard our natural resources, and ensure a sustainable future for generations to come.

voting.text: His official issues page says he has voted to expand voting rights and is focused on protecting them.
voting.quote: Rep. Kennedy has fought for equality and social justice, voting to legalize marriage equality, expand voting rights, and give striking workers access to unemployment benefits.

tax.text: His campaign proposes tax rebates to provide relief to working-class families.
tax.quote: Provide relief to struggling working class families through tax rebates

safety.text: He supports grants for cooperation between local and federal agencies under his safer-communities plan.
safety.quote: Support local and federal agency cooperation through grants

immigration.text: His campaign calls for enforcing immigration and border policies, prioritizing public safety, and strengthening worksite compliance.
immigration.quote: Enforce immigration and border protection policies with a priortization on serious public safety threats

gender.toward: rules based on sex at birth
gender.text: His campaign says spaces and opportunities should be safeguarded based on biological similarities.
gender.quote: Keep the protected classes protected: Safeguard spaces and opportunities based on biological similiarities

energy.text: His campaign proposes barring state and local governments from limiting energy sources and reducing red tape for energy extraction leases.
energy.quote: Prohibit state and local governments from banning or limiting specific energy sources
